from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
skill = Path(\".agents/skills/mei-shipping-excel\")
assert \"name: mei-shipping-excel\n\" in (skill / \"SKILL.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
ns = {\"m\": \"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main\"}
with ZipFile(skill / \"assets/mei-shipping-example.xlsx\") as archive:
    def read(name):
        return ET.fromstring(archive.read(name))
    book = read(\"xl/workbook.xml\")
    assert [sheet.attrib[\"name\"] for sheet in book.findall(\"m:sheets/m:sheet\", ns)] == [\"出貨總表\", \"包書明細\", \"買家分單\"]
    for i, expected in enumerate((\"A4:K7\", \"A4:I10\"), 1):
        sheet = read(f\"xl/worksheets/sheet{i}.xml\")
        assert sheet.find(\"m:autoFilter\", ns).attrib[\"ref\"] == expected
    summary = read(\"xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml\")
    detail = read(\"xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml\")
    split = read(\"xl/worksheets/sheet3.xml\")
    assert summary.find(\".//m:c[@r=\\\"D8\\\"]/m:v\", ns).text == \"990\"
    assert detail.find(\".//m:c[@r=\\\"H5\\\"]/m:f\", ns).text == \"F5*G5\"
    assert split.find(\".//m:c[@r=\\\"F8\\\"]/m:v\", ns).text == \"480\"
    for r in range(5, 8):
        assert summary.find(f\".//m:c[@r=\\\"I{r}\\\"]/m:v\", ns) is None
    xml = b\"\n\".join(archive.read(name) for name in archive.namelist() if name.endswith(\".xml\"))
    assert not re.search(rb\"(?<![0-9])09[0-9]{8}(?![0-9])|/Users/|https://lin\.ee/\", xml)
    assert not any(\"externallink\" in name.lower() or \"vbaproject\" in name.lower() for name in archive.namelist())
print(\"Synthetic package passed: sheet names/order, native filters, formulas, cached totals, blank phones, no external links or macros.\")
